text: It halfway worked. the one part that didnt seem to carry over are the collision physics of it. [Image #1]
resolution: Fixed the dumpster collision follow-up. The visual semantic recipe was correct, but static prop collision comes from the build catalog/placed-piece collider path, which still used the generic prop footprint square. Updated prop.dumpster's catalog size to use the shared dumpsterBodyMeters() helper, so placed-piece bounds, live collision, and compiled COLLIDERS lump now match the visible dumpster body. Added catalog, placed-collider, and compiled-collider regressions; focused suites pass. Full tools/rjit game verify still reports overall red only because its built-in oracle smoke query 'kinds' returns no RULINGS, while render proof, 89/89 suites, and 3/3 scripts are green.
